display.purpose: The BekiLang nameplate only. Archivo 900 at 62% width, uppercase.

headline.purpose: The compiler verdict; first phrase set as a shout block.

headline-section.purpose: Page-level heads outside the front grid, such as the cheat sheet.

title.purpose: Reporter names, classified ad titles, phase names (1.25rem), Run label (1.45rem). 75% width.

deck.purpose: Serif standfirst under the verdict headline, max 62ch.

body-serif.purpose: Story Time prose, max 65ch. Italic serif carries asides: tagline, roles, ad subtitles, colophon.

label.purpose: Field labels and small UI captions.

label-caps.purpose: Table column headers and transcript sub-section titles only.

code.purpose: The editor. 15.5px base; clamp(15.5px, 0.2rem + 0.9vw, 17px) at 1280px+, 14.5px under 720px. Ligatures off.

code-small.purpose: Console output, keyword chips, symbol data.

rules.name: rule-heavy
rules.purpose: Closes the dateline, tops the phase strip, underlines the cheat sheet head.

rules.name: rule-container
rules.purpose: Strokes every container, button, select and byline underline; tops each section bar.

rules.name: rule-hairline
rules.purpose: Column rules, table rows, phase and ad dividers.

rules.name: rule-dotted
rules.purpose: Token list rows in the transcript only.

textures.name: nameplate-halftone
textures.value: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28) 1.2px, transparent 1.7px) 0 0 / 7px 7px; mask-image: linear-gradient(100deg, transparent 38%, #000 100%)
textures.purpose: Four-colour press dot screen on the red nameplate plate only.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Shared easing for presses, flips, the headline press, caret and toast.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Active state on buttons and chips.

motion.name: hover-colour
motion.purpose: Hover fills; only under (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine).

motion.name: headline-press
motion.value: clip-path inset(0 0 100% 0) to inset(0) with translateY(-6px) to 0, 360ms ease-out; 160ms opacity fade under reduced motion
motion.purpose: Each new verdict is printed in from the top edge.

motion.name: phase-flip
motion.value: rotateX(-75deg) opacity 0.35 to rotateX(0) opacity 1, 280ms ease-out, delay 140ms + 110ms per cell, perspective 600px
motion.purpose: Departure-board restyle of the phase strip; skipped under reduced motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: transitions limited to background-color, color, border-color, opacity; animations to 0.01ms

breakpoints.name: wide
breakpoints.purpose: min-width: 7fr/5fr front grid with column rule; larger code size.

breakpoints.name: medium
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: editor full width; output and symbol table side by side.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: Story Time stacks; dateline beat hidden.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: single column; code 14.5px; toolbar two-cell grid.

editions.mechanism: Night tokens apply under :root[data-theme="dark"] and under prefers-color-scheme: dark unless data-theme="light". The toggle persists to localStorage key beki-theme and is applied before first paint.

icons.set: Phosphor Bold, self-hosted icon font in static/vendor/phosphor (third-party)
icons.usage: Always decorative (aria-hidden) and paired with a visible text label.

vendor: static/vendor/fonts (Archivo, Source Serif 4, JetBrains Mono woff2, OFL)

components.css: .ds-verdict { display: grid; gap: 14px; max-width: 560px; color: var(--ink, #151515); } .ds-headline { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-display, Archivo, 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif); font-stretch: 62%; font-weight: 900; font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 4.4vw, 4.4rem); line-height: 0.95; letter-spacing: -0.005em; text-transform: uppercase; text-wrap: balance; } .ds-shout { padding: 0 0.12em; background: var(--yellow, #ffd60a); color: var(--on-yellow, #151515); -webkit-box-decoration-break: clone; box-decoration-break: clone; } .ds-headline--error .ds-shout { background: var(--red, #d0201a); color: var(--on-red, #ffffff); } .ds-headline--error .ds-rest { color: var(--red-text, #be1c15); } .ds-deck { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-body, 'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif); font-size: 1.125rem; line-height: 1.45; color: var(--ink-2, #45443f); max-width: 62ch; }

components.css: .ds-phases { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); max-width: 560px; border-top: 4px solid var(--ink, #151515); font-family: var(--font-ui, Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif); color: var(--ink, #151515); } .ds-phase { display: grid; align-content: start; gap: 2px; padding: 10px 12px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule-soft, #c9c6be); transition: background-color 180ms ease, color 180ms ease; } .ds-phase + .ds-phase { border-left: 1px solid var(--rule-soft, #c9c6be); } .ds-phase__name { font-family: var(--font-display, Archivo, 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif); font-stretch: 75%; font-weight: 900; font-size: 1.25rem; line-height: 1.05; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-phase__role { font-size: 0.8125rem; line-height: 1.3; color: var(--ink-3, #66645e); } .ds-phase__state { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-top: 8px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink-3, #66645e); } .ds-phase--pass { background: var(--bar-bg, #151515); color: var(--bar-fg, #eeede9); } .ds-phase--pass .ds-phase__role, .ds-phase--pass .ds-phase__state { color: var(--bar-fg, #eeede9); opacity: 0.88; } .ds-phase--fail { background: var(--red, #d0201a); color: var(--on-red, #ffffff); } .ds-phase--fail .ds-phase__role, .ds-phase--fail .ds-phase__state { color: var(--on-red, #ffffff); }

narrative.overview:
Every run is today's front page. The Studio is set like a cheap, loud, well-ruled tabloid: grey newsprint stock, ink-black rules, reverse-type section bars, one rationed tabloid red and a highlighter-yellow marker pen. The compiler's verdict is the headline, the three phases are bylined reporters, the symbol table is a data box, and the keyword reference runs at the back as the classifieds. The voice is playful and the furniture is newspaper, but the hierarchy is strict: a visitor reads the verdict at a glance, then follows the stories down.

Density is editorial rather than dashboard: generous condensed headlines over tight, well-ruled columns of serif prose and monospaced data. Loudness comes from width and weight of type, from reverse bars and from the red, never from glow, gradients or depth. The system explicitly refuses the dark neon IDE-with-tabs default, and the old pink/cyan look is not carried forward.

There are two editions sharing one structure: the Day edition (newsprint) and the Night edition (dark stock), swapped by tokens only. Night is a recolour of the same paper, not a different product.
keyCharacteristics: Grey newsprint ground with a lighter "sheet" for anything the user writes or the compiler prints.
Heavy condensed all-caps Archivo headlines; Source Serif 4 for prose; JetBrains Mono for code and data.
Ink rules in three weights carry all structure; no shadows, no radius.
One rationed red (nameplate, Run, errors) and one highlighter yellow (success shout, hover, selection, focus).
Reverse-type ink bars head every section.
Motion is print-like: a headline "pressed" in from the top edge and a departure-board flip on the phase strip.

rules.name: The Rationed Red Rule
rules.body: Red appears only on the nameplate, the Run button and error states. It never decorates, never marks success, and never fills a container that is not one of those three.

rules.name: The Highlighter Rule
rules.body: Yellow is a marker pen, not a surface. It marks the success shout, hover, selection and focus; it never becomes a panel, card or section background.

rules.name: The Two Editions Rule
rules.body: Day and Night share every component and differ only in token values. A new surface must read correctly in both by using tokens, never literal greys.

rules.name: The Three Presses Rule
rules.body: Archivo shouts and labels, Source Serif 4 reports, JetBrains Mono quotes the machine. Code, identifiers, keywords, output and symbol data are always mono; prose about them is always serif.

rules.name: The Width Is Volume Rule
rules.body: Loudness is set by Archivo's width axis at weight 900: 62% for headlines and bars, 75% for titles and the Run label, normal width for UI. Never fake a headline with a larger regular-width weight.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number that lines up with another (line numbers, caret position, console counters, level and offset) uses tabular figures.

rules.name: The Front Page Rule
rules.body: The first viewport always shows the nameplate, the editor with Run, and the verdict. New content goes below the fold as another bylined section, never above the verdict.

rules.name: The Ruled Column Rule
rules.body: Columns are separated by 1px Soft Rule lines, not by cards, gaps alone or background changes.

rules.name: The Flat Newsprint Rule
rules.body: No shadows, glows, blurs or gradients on surfaces. If something needs to stand forward, give it a heavier ink rule or put it in a reverse bar.

rules.name: The Sharp Corner Rule
rules.body: Radius is 0 everywhere. A rounded corner reads as app chrome and breaks the newsprint.

dos: **Do** head every new section with the reverse-type Section Bar: a 62%-width all-caps title plus a plain-language meta line saying what the panel is.
**Do** keep red for the nameplate, Run and errors; use Headline Red Ink (#be1c15 day, #ff6b5e night) when red is text on paper.
**Do** use Highlighter Yellow (#ffd60a) with ink text for hover, selection, focus on the editor and the success shout.
**Do** put user code and compiler output on Fresh Sheet inside a 2px Press Ink box; set it in JetBrains Mono with ligatures off.
**Do** separate columns with 1px Soft Rule lines and close major bands with the 4px heavy rule.
**Do** pair every icon with a visible text label and mark the icon aria-hidden.
**Do** gate hover styles behind fine-pointer media queries and keep colour changes (but drop movement) under reduced motion.
**Do** define any new colour as a token with both a Day and a Night value.
donts: **Don't** add box-shadows, glows, blurs or gradient fills; the only texture is the nameplate halftone.
**Don't** use red for success, decoration or a second primary button.
**Don't** use yellow as a panel or section background.
**Don't** set headlines in regular-width Archivo or in the serif; headlines are 900 weight on the 62% or 75% width axis, all caps.
**Don't** wrap content in floating cards; hang ruled boxes under a bar instead.
**Don't** return to the dark neon IDE-with-tabs look or the old pink/cyan palette.
